commit.message: fix(a2a): one shared send-envelope schema kills the dead-letter drift (WP-02)

gates.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_a2a_envelope_schema.py tests/test_a2a_send.py tests/test_a2a_inbox_bridge.py tests/test_a2a.py tests/test_a2a_inbox_bridge_tmux_scripts.py -q
gates.name: a2a-envelope-schema-suite

intent: Hub-bulletproof WP-02 (14-point map item #7, HIGH, live bug): the A2A send path and the inbox-bridge drain each formatted their own envelope, so envelopes emitted by a2a_send.py carried no ack_subject while the drain demanded it, dead-lettering every grok_build/codex reply. This packet introduces one shared schema module (dharma_swarm/a2a/envelope_schema.py) that both emitters now call, keeping the DLQ for genuinely malformed envelopes (negative control holds). Known follow-up tracked outside this packet: scripts/runtime/devin_a2a_agent.py is a third emitter still on the inline schema. Built by hub-bulletproof Wave-0; independently re-verified by RUDRA W0 in a fresh workcell at the exact candidate SHA (146 tests green).

honest_blockers: packet originally bound to repository-titanium-hardening-2026-07; that track was superseded by governance PR #1444 while this branch was in review, so the binding moved to the live fleet-advancement-2026-08 track (same A2A bus substrate scope)
session_entry.rollback: git revert the WP-02 commit on branch wp02-a2a-envelope-schema; both emitters return to their inline schemas and the ack_subject dead-letter condition resurfaces
